open_risks.risk: Strict visibility, stability, monotonicity, and balance gates may reduce accepted-case yield.
open_risks.mitigation: Oversample by scan, episode, geometry tag, action motif, horizon, body profile, and tentative label before downsampling to balanced accepted manifests.

open_risks.risk: Visibility-gate tolerances could be implemented inconsistently across generator versions.
open_risks.mitigation: Serialize footprint sample spacing, temporal sample spacing, occlusion tolerance, visible decisive-sample fraction, and gate result in every accepted-case audit record.

open_risks.risk: Body Counterfactual can still invite size priors if control composition is not audited.
open_risks.mitigation: Require the per-30-pair quotas, report radius-only accuracy by control type, and block release if radius-only exceeds majority by more than 0.10.

open_risks.risk: Natural Chinese answers may vary outside canonical labels.
open_risks.mitigation: Use explicit canonical labels and alias maps; mark compound, multi-label, or explanatory answers invalid for automatic scoring unless manually audited.

open_risks.risk: Strict visibility, stability, monotonicity, balance, and coverage gates may reduce accepted-case yield.
open_risks.mitigation: Oversample stratified candidates across scans, episodes, geometry tags, action motifs, horizons, body profiles, and tentative labels before downsampling to release balance.

open_risks.risk: Support-risk labels can be invalid if Habitat rollout generation does not expose support_loss or navmesh_support_violation.
open_risks.mitigation: Render the three-way hazard variant without insufficient_support unless a concrete support field is available and true.

open_risks.risk: Prompt text can still drift from executed actions if downstream code uses category defaults as truth.
open_risks.mitigation: Treat metric_parameters as sampling defaults only and add prompt-render audits against serialized per-case metadata before release.

open_risks.risk: Strict visibility, stability, and balance gates may reduce accepted-case yield.
open_risks.mitigation: Oversample by scan, episode, action motif, horizon, geometry tag, body profile, and tentative label before downsampling.

open_risks.risk: Natural Chinese answers may still contain explanations or compound choices.
open_risks.mitigation: Score only canonical labels and explicit aliases automatically; mark unmatched, compound, or explanatory responses invalid unless manually audited.

open_risks.risk: Prompt values can drift from the executed rollout if generators use defaults.
open_risks.mitigation: Render all meters, body-width counts, step counts, action phrases, and turn clauses only from serialized per-case metadata; metric_parameters are sampling defaults only.

open_risks.risk: Radius-only or size-prior baselines may perform well if Body Counterfactual no-flip controls are too weak.
open_risks.mitigation: Require explicit per-30-pair quotas for small_only flips, both_safe controls, neither_safe controls, and large_shorter_same_label controls; report radius-only accuracy by subtype.

open_risks.risk: Hidden-geometry cases may pass if the visible-local gate is implemented loosely.
open_risks.mitigation: Serialize deterministic swept-footprint sampling density, temporal sampling stride, depth occlusion tolerance, and decisive-sample visibility fraction for each accepted case.

open_risks.risk: Prompt text can drift from executed rollouts if action_phrase carries step count or turn angle implicitly.
open_risks.mitigation: Render num_forward_steps, intended_distance_m, horizon_body_widths, and signed/total turn degrees as explicit template fields, including Body Counterfactual.

open_risks.risk: Answer balance can pass while scene or action coverage remains narrow.
open_risks.mitigation: Add release audit tables and dominance caps by scan_id, episode_id, action horizon, action motif, geometry_tag, and body radius.

open_risks.risk: Radius-only shortcuts may remain competitive on Body Counterfactual if no-flip controls are weak.
open_risks.mitigation: Add explicit per-30-pair quotas for small_only flips, both_safe controls, neither_safe controls, and large_shorter_same_label controls; audit radius-only accuracy by control type.

open_risks.risk: Prompt text may drift from executed rollout metadata when action_phrase carries the only step or turn information.
open_risks.mitigation: Render num_forward_steps, total_turn_deg, intended_distance_m, and body-width horizons as explicit serialized fields in every action-conditioned prompt.

open_risks.risk: Visible-local filtering may be hard to reproduce without numeric tolerances.
open_risks.mitigation: Specify deterministic swept-footprint sample spacing, temporal sampling, occlusion depth tolerance, and minimum visible decisive-sample fraction.

critique_items.issue: Body Counterfactual controls are still too vague in the blackboard draft, leaving a radius-prior shortcut.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Replace the vague control sentence with explicit per-30 accepted-pair quotas: 10-14 small_only true flips, 8-10 both_safe controls, 8-10 neither_safe controls, and at least 4 large_shorter_same_label controls; require no canonical label above 14/30.

critique_items.issue: Body Counterfactual monotonicity wording mixes progress and meter tolerance.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Use two separate checks: reject as oracle_error if actual_distance_small_m + distance_tolerance_m < actual_distance_large_m, or if progress_ratio_small + 0.05 < progress_ratio_large.

critique_items.issue: Body Counterfactual prompt relies too much on action_phrase for the action geometry.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Include explicit fields in the template: num_forward_steps, horizon_m, small_horizon_body_widths, large_horizon_body_widths, and total_turn_deg or a conditional turn_clause.

critique_items.issue: The visible-local gate lacks deterministic tolerance parameters.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Add generator validity parameters for footprint sample spacing, temporal sample spacing, depth occlusion tolerance, and minimum visible decisive-sample fraction; serialize them in every accepted case audit record.

critique_items.issue: Dataset-level shortcut audits cover answer share but not enough scene/action dominance controls.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Add a release gate requiring coverage tables and dominance caps by scan_id, episode_id, action horizon, action motif, geometry_tag, and body radius within each category.

critique_items.issue: Body Counterfactual no-flip controls are still not concretely quota-gated in the blackboard spec, leaving a radius-prior shortcut unresolved.
critique_items.proposed_fix: In body_counterfactual.coarse_labeling_rule, require per 30 accepted pairs: small_only true flips >=10, both_safe controls >=8, neither_safe controls >=8, large_shorter_same_label controls >=4; require radius-only baseline <= majority+0.10 before release.

critique_items.issue: Body Counterfactual prompt does not independently expose step count and total turn angle outside action_phrase.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Revise the template to include '前进部分共 {num_forward_steps} 步、约 {horizon_m} 米；总转向约 {total_turn_deg} 度' while preserving small/large body-width horizons.

critique_items.issue: The visible-local gate lacks deterministic implementation tolerances.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Add generator parameters for swept-footprint sample spacing, temporal sample spacing, depth occlusion tolerance, and required visible decisive-sample fraction; serialize these values in each accepted case audit record.

critique_items.issue: Dataset balance gates do not yet require coverage across scene/action factors in the proposed spec itself.
critique_items.proposed_fix: Add a release gate and manifest audit table for label, scan_id, episode_id, horizon, action motif, body radius, and geometry_tag distributions.
